subject: Request for brief pilot sustainment while PO undergoes audit
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@springboardhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Long <chris.long@springboardhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief pilot sustain while PO is audited

Hey Logan,

Quick note from our side — the procurement team started an audit on our suppliers this morning and they’ve put a hold on new POs. We have an approved budget and are committed to moving forward, but the PO timeline has slipped to Monday at the earliest.

We’re mid-way through the Springboard integration tests and the team would lose momentum if the sandbox is throttled. Would Redwood be able to keep the pilot environment live through the weekend (Fri evening until Mon morning) and provide a small token top-up so our engineers can finish the connector tests?

What we’re asking for: 72 hours of continuous sandbox access (no expiry over the weekend) and ~10k token credit to cover continued testing. We can return the exact PO and SOW on Monday; procurement is aware and will prioritize.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to sign a short interim terms doc if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Integrations, Springboard Health
elena@springboardhealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
Attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@springboardhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief pilot sustain while PO is audited

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and for the clarity on timing. We can definitely help keep momentum. Proposed interim plan:

- Provision 72 hours of uninterrupted sandbox access starting now (we’ll pause the trial timer).
- Issue a 5,000 token top-up immediately so your engineers can finish the connector tests.
- Provide an interim terms PDF outlining the limited extension and data retention commitments (attached).

If procurement can confirm they’ll deliver the PO by Monday EOD, we’ll make the temporary credits available without charge. If you need a bit more runway, we can discuss a second small top-up once we see the PO ETA.

I attached ‘Interim-terms-Redwood-v1.pdf’ — it’s intentionally lightweight: limited window, standard security assurances, and an invoice estimate. If procurement is comfortable, a quick reply from them is sufficient; otherwise we can route a DocuSign link.

Copying Camila (CS) and Kimberly (legal/finance) to keep them in the loop.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0123

Attachments: Interim-terms-Redwood-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Procurement Team <procure@springboardhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@springboardhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief pilot sustain while PO is audited

Hi Logan / Elena,

Thanks for the notes. Procurement here — we opened an expedited audit this morning focused on vendor compliance and invoicing headers. That means we can’t issue a formal PO until Monday. That said, we understand the business impact.

Two asks before we can approve any interim credit:
1) Vendor must confirm a short data retention clause for the temporary sandbox (we need assurance data remains within the test account and will be deleted after the extension).
2) Please provide an invoice estimate for the credits and confirm Redwood’s contact for reconciliation.

If those are acceptable, we can authorize a temporary access allowance to prevent test disruption. We prefer a DocuSign for the interim terms to keep the audit trail clean.

—Chris Long
Senior Procurement Manager, Springboard Health
procure@springboardhealth.com
+1 650-555-0784

Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief pilot sustain while PO is audited

Hi Chris / team —

Thanks for the clarity and for being pragmatic. Per your asks:

1) Data retention: Redwood confirms that any data created in the Springboard test workspace during the interim window will be isolated and removed within 48 hours of the extension expiring. We’ll include the clause in the DocuSign.

2) Invoice estimate: I’ve attached an invoice estimate and a CSV showing the credit allocation (sandbox-credits-20270502.csv). The estimated line item for a 5k token top-up + 72hr access management is listed. Our finance contact for reconciliation is Kimberly Park (kimberly@redwood.com).

DocuSign link to interim agreement: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/springboard-docusign-9842

Per our internal approvals (Camila and Kimberly copied), we will provision a 72-hour sandbox window and a 7,000 token uplift immediately upon a one-line confirmation from procurement (this is slightly above my initial offer to give you buffer). If procurement needs a formal signature, please sign the DocuSign and we’ll reconcile against the PO when it arrives.

Let me know if you’d like us to extend beyond Monday; we’re flexible but do ask for visibility on the PO ETA.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0123
